en: A vintage, lightly colorized postcard showing a rural sandy road lined with wooden fences and simple wooden buildings. Large boulders are scattered along the left side of the road, and there are trees in the background. A tower-like structure rises above the low buildings near the center of the image. Printed captions in Russian and German (or older Estonian usage) at the top identify the place, and a handwritten word in blue ink appears in the upper right corner.
